reportedStatus: Fault status reported in this record
referenceUnavailable: Related record unavailable in this selection
measurementHint: The value and physical unit belong to this illustrative sample. They do not establish calibration or units for real Karma fields. Zero is a value; an unavailable value remains unavailable.
evaluationHint: The input window describes the observations used. Evaluation processing can happen later; its timestamp is retained separately.
missingSignalsHint: These references did not provide a usable input value. This does not establish a sensor outage or a vehicle fault.
mapHint: Example data: this point is the exact position reference of the selected measurement. Its source time remains unchanged. It illustrates a fictional journey, not a real vehicle location.
noPosition: No valid position is linked to this measurement. Another record's coordinates are not substituted.

kindHints.FAULT_REPORTED: An illustrative fault report, separate from telemetry events and integration issues. The synthetic code is not a decoded manufacturer DTC.
kindHints.FAULT_STATUS: A status reported by the example source. Reported resolution does not confirm repair or ECU fault clearing.
kindHints.MEASUREMENT: An illustrative measurement record with its own sample reference and source time.
kindHints.AVAILABILITY: A missing value does not establish a sensor outage, a vehicle fault or a healthy vehicle. A sampling gap alone does not identify a sensor outage.
kindHints.INTEGRATION_ISSUE: An illustrative sanitized integration issue, separate from vehicle faults and DTCs. No raw protocol or production server-log payload is exposed.
kindHints.RULE_EVALUATION: A record of rule processing, separate from the observations in its input window. It is not a vehicle fault report.
